parts.html: The K-09 standard model is a contemporary gray kitchen with an island, glass upper fronts, and a natural quartzite countertop.
The main work zone runs along one wall, and the island stands separately as a second countertop.
The upper row of the K-09 has glass fronts, and the lower row is painted a solid gray. Thanks to the glass, the wall cabinets do not look like a blank wall.
Quartzite is a natural stone, each slab has its own pattern, and it shows up well against the solid gray fronts.
The kitchen is 6.7 linear meters long. The appliances are built in, and there is a cargo pull-out, AvanTech YOU Hettich drawers, and Hettich soft-close hinges.
We rework the K-09 for each specific kitchen. The island can be made larger or smaller, and the cabinets and their interiors can be arranged differently.
